name: research
description: Decision-oriented research orchestration, evidence planning, specialist investigation, synthesis, and independent review workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Turn open questions into decision-ready evidence.
interface.longDescription: A decision-research family for framing open questions, modeling decisions, mapping hypotheses, prioritizing evidence, conducting specialist research, synthesizing uncertainty, and independently reviewing whether a recommendation is ready to act on.
defaultPrompt: Research this open question and produce a decision-ready brief.
Determine what evidence would change this decision before collecting more information.
Compare these strategic alternatives using explicit criteria and current evidence.
Review this research brief for source quality, uncertainty, and decision readiness.
